title: Zero-Shot Visualization: Exploring Text Corpora with User-Prompted Axes
abstract: arXiv:2610.06889v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the application of large language models (LLMs) to the visual exploration of textual corpora. We introduce zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task in which users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto the corresponding concept axes for visualization. Building a ZSV system of practical value is non-trivial, as it requires choices at the intersection of feature functions, efficient implementation tradeoffs, and pre/post-processing decisions affecting visualization quality. To that end, we establish a benchmark that compares methods spanning embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation in this setting. Across multiple datasets and use cases we evaluate the properties of different scoring methods and design choices in terms of semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost. translated_title: 零样本可视化：基于用户提示轴的文本语料库探索
translated_abstract: 我们研究了大语言模型（LLM）在文本语料库可视化探索中的应用。我们提出了零样本可视化（ZSV）这一任务，即用户用自然语言指定概念，然后将文档映射到相应的概念轴上进行可视化。构建一个具有实用价值的ZSV系统并非易事，因为它需要在特征函数、高效实现的权衡以及影响可视化质量的预处理/后处理决策的交汇处做出选择。为此，我们建立了一个基准，比较了在此设置下涵盖嵌入相似度、直接语义判断和条件似然估计等多种方法。我们在多个数据集和用例上，从语义忠实性、评分保真度和计算成本等方面评估了不同评分方法和设计选择的特性。我们的结果表明，基于下一个词元概率的评分方法提供了……
tldr: 该论文提出了零样本可视化（ZSV）任务，允许用户通过自然语言指定概念轴来交互式探索文本语料库，并通过基准测试发现基于下一个词元概率的评分方法在语义忠实性、评分保真度和计算成本方面具有优势。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task enabling users to explore text corpora through natural-language-specified concept axes, and establishes a benchmark revealing that scoring based on next-token probabilities offers favorable properties in semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost.
